ayudaui.memProceso:
## What it does
Posts to the accounting system the supplier invoices that arrive through the **FAC_Facturas** queue.

## Triggers
- Dispatcher: every hour.
- Performer: queue trigger.

## Expected business exceptions
| BE001 | Duplicate invoice |
| BE002 | Unknown supplier |
ayudaui.memProd: - On Mondays before 9 am there are abandoned items because of accounting system maintenance.
ayudaui.hEsperado: Monday abandoned items: scheduled maintenance. This is normal.
ayudaui.sCriterios: Escalate anything that leaves a batch unprocessed.
ayudaui.sMatriz:
P1: critical process stopped or SLA breached today.
P2: degraded with SLA risk.
P3: isolated errors.
P4: informational.
ayudaui.d1Titulo: The Dispatcher runs every hour and the SDD says every 30 minutes
ayudaui.d1Detalle: The FAC_Cada_hora trigger starts FAC_Dispatcher every 60 minutes. The SDD, in the Triggers section, states a frequency of 30 minutes.
ayudaui.d1Sug: Confirm which frequency is correct and fix the trigger or the document.
ayudaui.d2Titulo: The FAC_Tolerancia asset used in the code does not exist in Orchestrator
ayudaui.d2Detalle: The Performer reads FAC_Tolerancia during initialization. The folder has no asset with that name.
ayudaui.d2Sug: Create the asset or remove the read from the code.
ayudaui.d3Detalle: The package includes the exception screenshots folder. They are not read, but it is better not to publish them.
ayudaui.d3Notas: The folder will be removed in the next version.
ayudaui.docMd:
# Solution Design Document

## Triggers

| Trigger | Process | Frequency |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FAC_Cada_hora | FAC_Dispatcher | Every 30 minutes |

## Exception handling

- Failed login: retry once and escalate.
- Duplicate invoice: business exception BE001.
